description: This file contains utility functions and a class (VTWorkflowUtils) for managing workflow-related operations in the vtiger CRM system, including user context management, module checks, and redirection.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for workflow operations such as user management, module validation, and redirection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the user stack if empty.

methods.name: validIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid identifier (starts with a letter, followed by letters, underscores, or digits).

methods.name: adminUser
methods.description: Pushes the active admin user onto the user stack and sets it as current user.

methods.name: loggedInUser
methods.description: Pushes the logged-in user onto the user stack and sets it as current user.

methods.name: revertUser
methods.description: Reverts to the previous user on the user stack.

methods.name: toWSModuleName
methods.description: Returns the web service module name for an entity, with special handling for 'Activity' type.

methods.name: redirectTo
methods.description: Outputs a JavaScript redirect and link to the specified URL with a message.

methods.name: checkAdminAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin access.

methods.name: checkModuleWorkflow
methods.description: Checks if a module supports workflow, excluding certain modules.

methods.name: vtGetModules
methods.description: Retrieves list of module names supporting workflow, excluding certain modules.
